record.name: Pipedrive
record.one_liner: Pipedrive is a CRM and sales pipeline management software providing a RESTful API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for integrations.

auth.notes: The API is stateless and all requests are validated against an API token obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.

access.notes: Developers can obtain a sandbox account and API tokens directly through self-service.

api_surface.notes: Pipedrive offers a RESTful API using JSON, OpenAPI 3 specifications, webhooks, and official Node.js and PHP client libraries.

mcp.notes: Pipedrive MCP is available to connect AI assistants to Pipedrive.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Pipedrive offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
evidence.quote: 14-day free trial, no credit card required

evidence.claim: The API is a RESTful API that validates requests against an API token.
evidence.quote: This reference helps you implement the RESTful Pipedrive API. This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests. The API is stateless – all requests are validated against an API token.

evidence.claim: The API token can be obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.
evidence.quote: The API token can be obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.

evidence.claim: Pipedrive MCP is available for connecting AI assistants.

auth.quote: The API is stateless – all requests are validated against an API token. The API token can be obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.

access.quote: To test your applications, we recommend creating a new, separate Pipedrive account for sandboxing purposes. Go to the Developer Sandbox Account page to learn more and request your own sandbox account.

api_surface.quote: This reference helps you implement the RESTful Pipedrive API. This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests.
